_doc: All keys optional. Copy to .claude/hooks/hook-overrides.json. The file is validated on every run: unknown keys, wrong types, bad enum values, unknown presets and undefined agents are fatal and visible. See SETUP.md and CONFIGURATION.md.
_comment: Preset provides defaults; explicit keys override it. To use a project checklist add "review_checklist_file": "review-checklist.md" (relative to .claude/hooks/, or absolute); the file must exist and replaces the built-in checklist.

security_checker.checks: authentication and authorization gaps, injection, secrets in code or logs

context_checks.api_routes: Check auth middleware, input validation, rate limiting
